scenarios.title: Rank retailers with the standing store method

lens.title: Same-store before total sales
lens.summary: Rank retailers on same-store sales growth before total sales growth.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.markdown: Rank retailers on same-store sales growth before total sales growth.

sections.heading: Use when
sections.markdown: Retailers that disclose both same-store sales growth and total sales growth.

sections.heading: Assumptions
sections.markdown: The company already computed same-store growth on a comparable set of stores.

sections.heading: Steps
sections.markdown: State same-store sales growth first. Do not rank on total sales when same-store growth is available.

sections.heading: Principles
sections.markdown: Chainwide sales can rise while established stores shrink.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.markdown: Do not apply the method when same-store growth is absent, or to companies that are not retailers.

turns.user: Which of these two retailers should I put first? Larkspur Retail same-store sales growth 4 percent, total sales growth 11 percent. Hearthlane Grocery same-store sales growth 6 percent, total sales growth 2 percent.

values: Hearthlane Grocery grew more in its established stores
Hearthlane Grocery has higher same-store growth
Hearthlane Grocery had higher same-store growth
Hearthlane Grocery’s same-store growth is higher
Hearthlane Grocery's same-store growth is higher
Hearthlane Grocery의 동일점포 매출 성장률이 더 높
Hearthlane Grocery의 기존 점포 매출 성장률이 더 높

rubric.criterion: The answer puts Hearthlane Grocery first because same-store growth is 6 percent versus 4 percent, and does not rank Larkspur first on total sales.
